description: From XP's connected resale order book. Use when a listing identifier is in hand and a buyer wants the full record for one open listing on the XP marketplace before they make an offer (make_offer_on_listing) or buy it at the ask (buy_listing_now). Returns one row from the live offer book. Requires auth and read:bids scope. This is the offer/negotiation surface -- for a plain buy-now at the asking price without an offer, use search_events and get_ticket_listings instead.
name: get_open_listing
title: Get Open Listing
